description.zh: 经典国际象棋。支持双人对弈与人机对战（简单/中等/困难三档 AI），完整规则——王车易位、吃过路兵、升变、将军、将死、逼和、50 回合与三次重复和棋，附带悔棋、标准记谱与胜负统计。
description.en: Classic Chess with two-player mode and VS Computer (Easy/Medium/Hard AI). Full rule support - castling, en passant, promotion, check, checkmate, stalemate, fifty-move and threefold draws. Includes undo, standard algebraic notation and win stats.

controls.zh: 鼠标点击选子，再点击目标位置落子
controls.en: Click a piece, then click the destination
